round_summary: Dispatcher reasoning-quality round: bring dispatchSystemPrompt's reasoning guidance up to Compass's systemPrompt.ts standard (worked examples, explicit note-vs-instruction disambiguation rule, messy-phrasing/voice-transcript guidance) and prove improvement with literal before/after evidence on a varied real test set. Prior initiative (adapt-compass-pattern-d1-and-user-lock) archived to FIX_STATE_v3_archive.json.

compass_files_read: compass/src/ai/agent.ts (pattern confirmed in earlier round; this round is about PROMPT QUALITY)
reference_notes.quality_bar_from_compass: Compass's buildSystemPrompt gives ~210 lines of behavioral guidance on top of injected live state: named disambiguation rules stated as explicit contrasts (pause_task vs cancel_task with example phrases on each side), explicit 'USE THE TOOL, don't just describe what you'd do', fuzzy-matching instructions with a ONE-clarifying-question fallback for ambiguous matches, per-domain worked scenarios (user says they finished something -> fuzzy-match open tasks -> status=done), and explicit reasoning instructions for messy real-world signals (relative time anchoring, never guess, never hedge). Codex's dispatchSystemPrompt is currently 3 classification bullets + 4 path bullets with NO worked examples and NO explicit note-vs-instruction rule.
reference_notes.codex_prompt_confirmed_current_state: worker/src/gemini.js dispatchSystemPrompt(tree) lines 585-601: one-line role + injected tree + 3 classification bullets + 4 path-targeting bullets. Two thin rules directly implicated by before-evidence: (1) 'If the user gives you information without an explicit command, that is a note to save' collides with (2) 'a question -> do NOT call any function' — a rhetorical self-reflection question (S2) was treated as small talk and never filed. Path targeting rules say nothing about matching ENTRY CONTENT PREVIEWS for read requests — S8's content-described read ('that long note about nonchalant people') resolved to the wrong topic by title association.
reference_notes.voice_flow_confirmed: media.js: voice/audio is transcribeAndClean'ed then routed through the SAME routeFreeText -> classifyAndDispatch path as typed text (confirmed lines 200-230). Transcripts arrive cleaned but still carry spoken register (hedges, false starts, run-ons) — so text-based harness testing with transcript-shaped inputs is representative.

fixes.before_summary: 16/18 correct. Two reproduced reasoning failures, both in the reasoning-guidance layer this round targets: (1) rhetorical/reflective NOTE phrased as a question is answered conversationally and never saved (prompt's 'question -> no tool' bullet overrides its own 'information without a command -> note' bullet); (2) content-described read resolves by topic-title association instead of entry-content previews. No instruction-as-note misfire reproduced in this run — the evidence shows the CURRENT model+prompt handles clear indirect instructions, so fix-02 hardens the ACTUAL demonstrated weak boundaries (note-vs-question, content-vs-title targeting, and the general messy-phrasing rule) rather than adding a special case for one phrasing.

fixes.name: Rewrite dispatchSystemPrompt with Compass-quality reasoning guidance
fixes.plan: Expand dispatchSystemPrompt(tree): keep role line, live tree injection, and the 4 path-targeting bullets; add (1) explicit named NOTE vs INSTRUCTION disambiguation rule with contrasting worked examples on each side INCLUDING borderline phrasings (rhetorical questions, imperative-shaped notes, hedged instructions); (2) explicit rule that grammatical mood/question-mark is a WEAK signal — decide by what the user would want to HAPPEN, and specifically that a musing/rhetorical question about the user's own life is a NOTE (file it), only a question asking the BOT for an answer/opinion is conversational; (3) messy-phrasing rule (filler words, false starts, run-ons, missing punctuation do NOT by themselves make something a note); (4) content-described read rule: match entry PREVIEWS not just topic titles; (5) USE THE TOOL reinforcement; (6) tighten file_note's description so it is not the ambiguity catch-all.
